title: End-to-End Fix: Inventory & Barcode Slices (Backend + Frontend)
acceptance_criteria: Delete all hardcoded mock arrays and localStorage inventory state from React inventory components.
InventoryDashboard queries live GET /api/v1/inventory/items?householdId=... via ediensApi.inventory.getItems and renders real DB items with FEFO status badges.
AddInventoryModal creates real items via POST /api/v1/inventory/items and supports EAN-13 barcode autofill via ediensApi.products.getByBarcode.
Consuming quantity sends PATCH /api/v1/inventory/items/{id} with If-Match ETag header.
When a concurrent modification occurs (409 Conflict), the UI captures the ProblemDetails response and triggers ConflictResolutionModal with actual server quantity.
Deleting an inventory batch issues real DELETE /api/v1/inventory/items/{id}.
